findings.evidence: Lines 165–182 expose the definition and use `rfl`; analogous APIs such as `Topology/Covering/Monodromy/Basic.lean:81` and `Algebra/Category/ModuleCat/DirectedUnion.lean:73` keep functors sealed and state map lemmas with `eqToHom`.
findings.fix: Seal the definition and state `presentationFunctor_map` with `eqToHom` transports along `presentationFunctor_obj`, following the existing sealed-functor APIs in the repository.
findings.issue: `presentationFunctor` is marked `@[expose]`, making the entire functor body public merely to obtain an untransported map equation.

findings.evidence: Lines 157–170 define `num := insert p.den p.num * insert q.den q.num` and `den := p.den * q.den`; the only following public lemmas, `le_prod_left` and `le_prod_right`, do not expose either projection.
findings.fix: Add `[simp]` lemmas for `(p.prod q).num` and `(p.prod q).den` (and a membership iff for the numerator if downstream reasoning needs membership).
findings.issue: The opaque `Presentation.prod` has no characteristic API for its numerator and denominator, so consumers using its advertised intersection presentation must unfold its implementation.

summary: The new functor and product presentation expose implementation details instead of providing sealed, characteristic APIs.
